title: poc_writer + poc worker consume live dict findings and resolve repo-relative evidence
acceptance_criteria: poc_writer coerces a dict finding (the live session-row shape) into a Finding so template resolution and grounding work; Finding objects still supported.
Grounding resolves a repo-relative cited evidence path against the target repo root (Target.repo_root or a directory-path-string target).
The poc worker run_stage builds a repo-root-bearing target from context['repo'] while preserving the display target slug.
All poc oracles (existing wired + CWE-94/22 + live-dict-finding + worker-live-finding + repair) pass; no regression.

spec.objective: Whole-file-replace ngv2/poc_writer.py (add _coerce_finding, _repo_root, _resolve_evidence; coerce at write_poc/synthesize/ground_finding/draft_poc; resolve evidence against repo root in default_resolver) and ngv2/workers/poc.py (add _RepoTarget + _build_target; run_stage passes a repo-root-bearing target) so live dict findings synthesize grounded, target-importing PoCs end-to-end.
functional_requirements: Submission is a whole-file manifest for ngv2/poc_writer.py AND ngv2/workers/poc.py.
spec.interfaces: Public signatures unchanged (write_poc/synthesize/ground_finding/draft_poc/run_stage); dict findings and repo-root targets are now accepted.
edge_cases: untemplatable category (e.g. CWE-862) -> honest failure artifact, no crash
display target slug preserved in artifacts
